decisions.reason: As a Magento shop template closely linked to the firm's hosting and shop-project business, it fits existing knowledge and customer relationships well enough that management would likely keep it and improve it through learning.
A responsive website template is very close to the firm's established web, CMS, and agency-oriented offer, so absorptive capacity is high and early market feedback should be easy to use commercially.
Premium customer support extends the firm's core 24/7 service model directly, making it highly complementary to current capabilities and therefore unlikely to be withdrawn.

A software version management tool builds on the firm's technical operations, management tools, and in-house development, so management would expect it to benefit from strong internal learning and refinement.

An online tool for creating data processing contracts is comparatively distant from the firm's core hosting and support knowledge base, so despite its visibility the firm is less able to learn and improve it efficiently and would be more likely to redeploy resources elsewhere.
